achievements.description: Throw three ingredients into the boiling pot in the kitchen.

achievements.name: Highly Sprung
achievements.description: Find any bed and jump on it about six times until it breaks.

achievements.name: Rascal
achievements.description: Smash all 10 porcelain statues scattered across every chapter.

achievements.name: Light Up Your Life
achievements.description: Not all lights can be trusted, but these should be quite safe!

achievements.name: The Prison
achievements.description: Look how the canary has flown its cage!

achievements.name: The Lair
achievements.description: Little lost things sometimes find their way home.

achievements.name: The Kitchen
achievements.description: The Chefs will miss you!

achievements.name: The Guest Area
achievements.description: Little fox among hungry wolves!

achievements.name: The Lady's Quarters
achievements.description: A storm is coming. That coat should come in useful.

achievements.name: Elusive
achievements.description: Narrowly escape being caught by a pursuer six times across chapters two through four.

achievements.name: Six's Song
achievements.description: Climb onto the piano in chapter two and play its keys.

achievements.name: Hard to the Core
achievements.description: What’s different about you? Why are you so brave?

achievements.name: So Close
achievements.description: You'll do better next time.

achievements.name: Not Alone
achievements.description: What's new with you?

achievements.name: Fun & Games Ahead
achievements.description: Pick up the ball and throw it into the waiting basket.

achievements.name: End in Sight
achievements.description: The final stretch will be largely uneventful.

achievements.name: Is Anybody Out There?
achievements.description: I wish I could visit you there.

achievements.name: Ashes in The Maw
achievements.description: In The Depths, complete the furnace puzzle - lure, lever, saw, and wooden gnome - by throwing the gnome into the fire.

achievements.name: We'll Meet Again
achievements.description: Reach the end of The Residence, the third and final Secrets of the Maw episode.

achievements.name: Ashes to Ashes
achievements.description: In The Hideaway, reunite both halves of a hidden book to open a secret door, then knock over the vase inside.

achievements.name: I'm Losing You
achievements.description: Collect all 5 Flotsam bottles hidden throughout The Residence.
